t: Magnusson extra-fine hand sanding sheets are designed for manual surface preparation and material removal. The 280 x 230mm high-performance abrasive sheets feature a 240 grit silicon carbide grain on a durable, waterproof latex paper backing. Ideal for painters, decorators, and carpenters working on wood and metal, these sheets are suitable for both wet and dry sanding. The versatile multi-material design delivers a smooth, consistent and professional finish on delicate and hard surfaces. The pack contains 4 sheets, each offering excellent strength and a sharp cutting action for trade professionals seeking a reliable, high-quality finish.
b: Durable Backing Prevents Sheet Tearing & Slipping

Sheet Dimensions Offer Broad Abrasive Coverage
